about: cmux Cloud backend paths in this repository. New cloud backend code (control plane, provider drivers, metering and billing, the hand-off server, entitlements, the NEXT Worker) goes to the private repository manaflow-ai/cmux-platform; the code below moves there one PR-sized move at a time (it lands in cmux-platform first, a follow-up deletes it here). The client, CLI, GUI and protocol stay here, so `stays` lists the paths under a backend path that are not backend. scripts/ci/pr_cloud_backend_check.py warns, never fails, when a pull request adds or changes a backend path and its description has no `cmux-platform:` line. A path is a file or a directory (everything under it).
